intent: Inspect and refactor IngressPacket without changing the ast_hints surface or the tests' behavior (never seal or finalize a type another unit stubs; no magic numbers, no blocking calls, no raw logger calls beyond the claimed step logs). Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation. Immutable record Ingress Packet: the raw payload from a device carrying one or more Telemetry Samples. Invariants: non-null components, non-blank deviceId, at least one sample (IllegalArgumentException otherwise), unmodifiable copy of the sample list.
